svg.title: GS1 parameter–performance Pareto frontier
svg.desc: Decision Index public text evaluation, 10 November 2026 (UTC): Public index scores for GS1 0.8B, 2B, 4B and 9B are 56.12, 62.22, 68.97 and 70.45. The 33 displayed comparison models retain the technical-report snapshot of 6 November 2026. The frontier refers to these displayed models. Jev 1.14 has a reference score of 60.70; its parameter count is undisclosed.
